mapper.sql: SELECT pd.property_doc_idx AS propertyDocIdx, pd.prop_idx AS propIdx, pd.file_name AS fileName, pd.stored_name AS storedName, pd.file_size AS fileSize, pd.content_type AS contentType, pd.attachment_base_date AS attachmentBaseDate, CAST(pd.attached_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS attachedAt, CAST(pd.modified_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS modifiedAt, pd.modified_by AS modifiedBy, um.user_name AS modifiedByNm, pd.deleted_yn AS deletedYn FROM property_doc pd LEFT JOIN user_mst um ON um.user_id = pd.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO property_doc ( prop_idx, file_name, stored_name, file_size, content_type, attachment_base_date, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{propIdx}, #{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{attachmentBaseDate}, #{modifiedBy} )
